prohibited: treating SS64 as a binary repository

native_resolution_order: Octavian native implementation when a target-native runtime exists
binary already present in the target rootfs
official distribution/package provider staged by the build or installer
compatibility shim with explicit provider-missing status

binary_staging.source: target rootfs or official package provider

native_build.compiler: target-specific Linux cross compiler from the eight-ABI matrix
native_build.policy: The shared POSIX multicall source provides hosted Linux user-space command binaries only. It is not a Koronos-native implementation. Other catalogued commands must resolve to a staged provider or remain explicitly unavailable; catalog membership never implies an executable exists.
native_build.artifact_abi: Linux userspace ELF; not executable by Koronos until a compatible Linux syscall layer is implemented.
native_build.target_scope: Seven Linux userspace ABI cross-build candidates with native/QEMU-user smoke tests; not seven Koronos kernel ports.

isa_execution.scope: OctavianOS currently mirrors the ISA reference catalogue only. It does not claim a complete encoder, decoder, emulator, JIT, or native kernel execution backend for the 104 architecture rows.
isa_execution.foreign_execution: Requires a validated architecture-specific decoder/lowering backend or compatible emulation runtime; unsupported instructions must fail closed.
